notes: po/opo: 1,000 positives and 1,000 length-matched negatives (7.6 and 7.5 words); 247 positives and 51 negatives have a respect or address cue in the English; 753 cue-free positives.
ay: 1,000 and 1,000 (11.9 and 11.7 words); cue 50 and 55. The ay labels come from the provisional rule and need the A5 hand labels.

Alignment screen: sentence chrF of MADLAD-400-3B fil->en against the subtitle English >= 54.88, the lowest threshold with >= 85% of 200 Codex-labelled calibration pairs fully aligned above it (52/61); recall of fully aligned pairs 38%.
Training exclusion for A3: data/probes/probe-v1-exclusion-sides.json (7,834 hashed normalised sides).
A pair can appear in both sets (the sets are built independently).
